verdict.rationale: Medusa documents a dedicated Inventory Module and Fulfillment Module, and a community user praised its backend GUI for managing inventory. However, the evidence is mostly page titles, so the specific multi-location and warehouse-routing elements of the story are not shown. Missing for 10: evidence of multi-location stock tracking, stock adjustment workflows, fulfillment routing from the correct warehouse/location, and independent hands-on corroboration of those capabilities.
